CustomField.description: Comma-delimited lowercase substrings that recognise this persona in a Contact title. A DETERMINISTIC synonym list and never a model, per the twenty-fourth stamp's ruling on title normalisation. Facts about words rather than a methodology statement, which is why our seed can carry these while it correctly carries no expectation content. A title matching more than one persona matches NONE and is reported: exactly one match links, more than one is ambiguous and holds, which is the identity ladder's own discipline.
CustomField.label: Title Patterns
